Method of Attack: Execution of arbitrary code via maliciously-crafted Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol (XMPP) messages
File transfer containing malicious .exe file forced to be accepted using an XSS attack
Impacted Systems: Cisco Jabber for Windows versions 12.1 to 12.9
Attack Vector: Malicious XMPP messages sent to authenticated users with access to XMPP domains
